checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is now a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the new apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA normalizes tree roots and rejects exact render-hierarchy duplicates among simultaneously active generated fallbacks.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present. Cause-based low understory reuses the same thin-leaf optical model and supplies four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources. Repetition QA requires at least five unique ecology-patch hierarchy fingerprints and no exact natural patch more than twice.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass deletes the legacy WeatheringOverlays primitive-cube root and reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration. Park-furniture microtextures and apartment curtain textures are restricted to manufacture-scale structure and explicitly leave macro runoff, exposure and occupancy differences to causal systems.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light understory foliage, eight 1024px park/street-furniture PBR sets, and four curtain-fabric families with 512px textile normal/albedo structure. Curtain cloth and coated tracks remain dielectric; LOD0 cloth uses physical 55 mm pleat geometry and 0.18 m metre-derived textile UVs.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing refresh and outdoor BlendProbesAndSkybox renderer policy.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation explicitly skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Window dressing metadata records track/fabric manufacture, dimensions, mounting, glass/cloth/backing clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split, LOD policy and a precise frontal/oblique/grazing lookdev brief.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before capture. Scene-save gates make non-primitive facade weathering, vegetation ecology, manufactured park/street furniture and the new apartment occupancy/repetition QA persisted invariants whenever the detailed generated benchmark prerequisites exist. Environment construction performs a scene save after facade optics, which triggers the occupancy/repetition gate before final capture-scene reopen and realtime-probe refresh.

Capture contract records exact view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. The repetition contract identifies facade_center, facade_right, ground_contact, vegetation_grounding and tree_shadow_contact as mandatory repetition review crops; no static check is allowed to clear the critical repeated-pattern defect visually.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection only for this pass. All newly created files are under UnityProject. The facade occupancy pass keeps regular manufactured sash geometry intact but inserts 30 deterministic occupied-apartment dressing assemblies between clear glazing and the existing room backing. LOD0 uses dedicated metre-UV pleated cloth meshes (55 mm pitch, 12 mm amplitude), coated-aluminium track geometry and dry dielectric textile PBR; LOD1-3 progressively simplify behind glass with animated cross-fade. Static QA requires >=18 unique LOD0 curtain signatures (the deterministic source produces 30 distinct signatures in an offline algorithm check), exact natural-tree hierarchy uniqueness among generated fallbacks, >=5/6 unique ecology patch fingerprints, and existing metre/world-phase ground QA. A sceneSaving gate applies/validates the occupancy and clone-risk pass whenever GroundHighDetail and DanchiFacadeOptics are present; QualityBlockEnvironmentLightingUpgrade saves the scene after facade optics, so this path is part of the current 4K preparation chain. Commit status contexts and workflow runs on the substantive head are zero, and Assets/QA/Captures4K returns Not Found. No Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile, native 3840x2160 render or 100% crop exists, so Visual Fidelity remains unscored and zero points are awarded from this work.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Period accuracy/scene authenticity: regular mass-produced housing construction remains regular while occupant-controlled curtain opening/material/hem differences create plausible lived-in variation instead of thirty cloned dark window cards.

Geometry & construction fidelity: LOD0 curtain macro pleats and coated track are physical geometry placed between glass and the 180 mm room backing; opening gaps are geometry rather than painted stripes.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: four dry curtain textile families remain metallic=0 with rough dielectric response and textile normals; coated aluminium track is treated as dielectric at the visible coating surface; no emission or baked highlight is permitted.
Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: curtain weave uses 512px repeating yarn-scale normal/albedo with 0.18 m physical UV scale on LOD0, while broad ground anti-repeat remains metre/world-phase based.

Vegetation/natural complexity and critical-defect risk: root-normalized hierarchy fingerprints reject exact generated-tree clones and overly duplicated ecology patches without falsely randomizing authentic manufactured modules.
Temporal/LOD stability: each of 30 dressing assemblies has explicit LOD0/1/2/3 with animated cross-fade; actual pop/shimmer still requires runtime motion evidence.
